answer: The cheapest real defence: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because ledge only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, lagoon is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any lantern approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
